comment: Param 18, the second snap setting, and param 19, a patch version number, have no control on the panel. The two snap menu items in WVCOModule.cpp are inside an #if 0 block and are not in the shipped build, so the entry no longer mentions them. The manual says the Ratio knob goes 1, 2, 3; the composite configures it 1 to 16. The FM input is read one channel per bank of four (WVCO.h:416 uses getPolyVoltage at the base channel of each bank), so channels 1, 5, 9 and 13 of a polyphonic cable set the FM for the four voices in their bank.
